committee.sub: Morning brief · Thursday 26 November 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Paid Search spend is A$0 this week versus A$6.27 last week, creditRemainingExGst sits at A$0, and campaignStatus reads PAUSED, consistent with the rule to pause unless cost per qualified enquiry is A$480 or under with at least one review booked.

Search Console data runs through 23 Nov, two days behind yesterday (25 Nov), so visibility figures lag; totalPaidClicks has reached 108, well past the 75-click checkpoint, so the relevant and qualified counts need confirming in the test log.
Since the test began, ask_cta_click sits at 11 and quick_question_click at 5, but review_cta_click is still 0, so visitors keep taking the shallow question form rather than booking the deeper review.

Organic Search is the only trustworthy signal this week, up to 11 sessions from 5 (google / organic 10 vs 4), while Direct fell from 14 to 7, which fits it being untracked traffic rather than real demand; AI Assistant sessions stayed at 0 both weeks.

actions.text: With creditRemainingExGst at A$0 the decision point is live: resume spend only if cost per qualified enquiry is A$480 or less and at least one qualified prospect has booked, otherwise leave the campaign paused as it already is.

totalPaidClicks has passed 75 (now 108): have Chris check the test log for relevant and qualified counts; if relevant clicks are 75 or more with zero qualified enquiries, the red flag fires. The page stays frozen past click 25, no further copy or CTA changes.

eventsSinceStart shows 3 generate_lead fires since the test started: check the Formspree and Cal.com emails for source detail and grade each against the qualified rule (real business, repeatable admin process, named system) in the test log.
Standing item: logo and image assets are still needed for the serving ad groups.
Standing item: RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still claim 13.3 hours of admin per week and 99.6% success and need updating to current site stats.
